description: 5000run: the TRON dataset, preprocessed by fall26/preprocess_forecast_ds.py on the sachin branch (raw source: NERSC /pscratch/sd/s/sachinv/5000run).

split_rule.method: interleaved contiguous chunks: 3 validation + 3 test, separate positions, gaps excluded
split_rule.rounding: validation = test = floor(0.15 * (N - 120)), split as evenly as possible over 3 chunks (earlier chunks get the extra dump); chunk start = round(centre * N - size / 2); train = all remaining non-excluded dumps

usage_rules: Each split is a set of contiguous chunks (see 'segments'). Excluded dumps belong to no split; never use them.
Every input frame AND every target frame of a sample (including every rollout step) must lie in ONE chunk of ONE split. Windows never span a gap or two chunks.
Fit any normalization or preprocessing statistics on train only.
Select checkpoints and hyperparameters on validation only. Use test only for final evaluation.
Data are physical (unnormalized) values; models normalize internally and must return physical values.
Do not edit this file. A changed split is a new version with a new filename.
notes: Use the main-folder copy of every dump (confirmed correct by the benchmark owner, 2026-11-14). blind/dump_5000-5700 is an outdated preprocessing (utilde1 differs everywhere) and must not be used.
Dumps start at t = 0, so the initial transient falls in train.
